work_package: ffap-instrumentation (FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked: the instance and its side channels)
scope: FEATUREFINDER/FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked.h/.cpp: the object state across runs (aborts_, abort_reasons_, log_, isotope_distributions_, param_), run into a caller's non-empty FeatureMap, the DefaultParamHandler surface, the ProgressLogger base (20 call sites), write_debug (log_ text, per-charge seed maps, abort map, debug input) and writeFeatureDebugInfo_ (.dta, _cropped.dta, .plot), and FeatureFinderCentroided -algorithm:write_debug.
method: Executed differential against the Linux x86_64 Release build. drivers/ffap_instr_driver.cpp subclasses FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked (reading its protected members) and prints maps with floats as IEEE-754 bit patterns; drivers/ffap_progress_driver.cpp defines time() as a counter (exported with -rdynamic, so libOpenMS.so's ProgressLogger forwards every setProgress call) and records every progress call with a ProgressLoggerImpl, measures the double a string or list ParamValue converts to, runs write_debug with such a shift, and exercises a refused parameter set; tool_cases.py runs the Release FeatureFinderCentroided. make_fixtures.py copies the outputs of the .1 repetitions into this directory; the other repetitions were compared and differ only in timing text and in the random map ids the driver draws outside test mode.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed, Linux x86_64 Release, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1) for every compared output; tier 4 for the refused undefined cases (zero-charge SIGFPE, stale abort seeds SIGSEGV, a heap-address shift where an address below 2^47 - 4096 changes the written text), whose executed signals or varying outputs are recorded but have no value to compare; tier 3 (source-reviewed) for setName, getSubsections and operator== of the DefaultParamHandler base.

external_reference_note: No C++ is committed to this repository. The driver, the scripts, the inputs and the raw outputs live under ../oracle/ffap-instr-completion (relative to the repository root); the entries below pin them.
cpp_issue_candidates: writeFeatureDebugInfo_ reads the undeclared debug:pseudo_rt_shift (declared: advanced:pseudo_rt_shift); every write_debug run that reaches the fit terminates with SIGABRT (executed)

abort_reasons_ is never cleared; a reused object's abort map reads the earlier runs' spectrum and peak indices in the new input: the new peaks on an input of the same shape, SIGSEGV on a shorter one (executed)
abort_reasons_ is a std::map<Seed, std::string> keyed by intensity only: seeds of equal intensity collapse to one entry
isotope_distributions_ is never cleared; a reused object appends windows and its second run differs from a fresh object's (executed)
log_ is reopened on every debug run while still open; the open fails and later runs of the object write no log (executed)
step 4 computes f2.getCharge() % f1.getCharge() without a zero check; a caller's feature of charge 0 traps (SIGFPE, executed)
aborts_ and abort_reasons_ are written inside the parallel region without synchronisation; at OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 the debug log differs between runs (executed)
setParameters assigns param_ before the checks, so a rejected set is kept (executed)

ParamValue::operator double() returns the union member dou_ for string and list values, i.e. the bits of a heap pointer; writeFeatureDebugInfo_ with a string debug:pseudo_rt_shift writes address-dependent numbers near RT 0 (executed)
